title: Prior Payment Plans and the Plan Percentage, by Floor Plan
content:
The plan percentage of an Apartment Home Lease payment plan follows the payment plan history of the lease: a lease with a completed payment plan on record and no defaulted plan on record has a plan percentage of the floor plan's minimum down payment share less 0.10; a lease with a defaulted plan on record has a plan percentage of the floor plan's minimum down payment share plus 0.10; any other lease keeps the floor plan's minimum down payment share.

**Records read.** The payment plan requests of the lease, at any date, by status: completed, or defaulted.

## History table

| Completed plan on record | Defaulted plan on record | Plan percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | minimum down payment share less 0.10 |
| either | Yes | minimum down payment share plus 0.10 |
| No | No | minimum down payment share |

A defaulted plan on record governs even when a completed plan is also on record.

## Schedule by floor plan

| Floor plan | Minimum down payment share | Completed plan, none defaulted | Defaulted plan on record | No plan history |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 0.50 | 0.40 | 0.60 | 0.50 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 0.50 | 0.40 | 0.60 | 0.50 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 0.40 | 0.30 | 0.50 | 0.40 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 0.40 | 0.30 | 0.50 | 0.40 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 0.40 | 0.30 | 0.50 | 0.40 |
| Penthouse Residence | 0.33 | 0.23 | 0.43 | 0.33 |
